Declared HS 680293 (worked granite, polished) does NOT match the observed shipments: actual codes seen are 25151210 (marble blocks, merely cut), 25162000 (sandstone blocks) and 68022190 (worked marble slabs) - per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual HS should be recorded as 25151210 / 68022190 (marble) with 25162000 (sandstone) as secondary. Note the two ImportKey pages carry two different addresses (Kapasan Road vs Meera Nagar, both Kishangarh-area marble cluster addresses) and slightly different name spellings ("AND" vs "&"), so the 8-record and 16-record sets may be the same proprietor under two name variants or two related entities - not resolvable from public free data.
